question: What courses are offered by the college?
answer: SRIT (Srinivasa Ramanujan Institute of Technology), Anantapur, offers B.Tech programs in Computer Science and Engineering (CSE), CSE with Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI&ML), CSE with Artificial Intelligence and Data Science (AI&DS), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE), Mechanical Engineering, and Civil Engineering. Postgraduate programs include M.Tech in Computer Science, Electrical Power Systems, and VLSI Design. For the latest details, visit https://www.srit.ac.in/courses-offered/.

question: How can I apply for admission?
answer: SRIT offers admissions through Category A counselling, Category B management seats, and B.Tech lateral entry. Category A admissions are based on AP EAPCET ranks and applicable reservation rules. Category B admissions are handled by the college management according to APSCHE guidelines. Eligible diploma holders can apply for second-year B.Tech admission through AP ECET counselling. Eligibility and admission rules may change, so check https://www.srit.ac.in/admission-procedure/ or contact the college at 9515611111.

question: What are the college working hours?
answer: For the latest college working hours, class timings, and office timings at SRIT, please contact the college office at 9515611111 or email hr@srit.ac.in. The official website is https://www.srit.ac.in/. Please confirm the current schedule with the college because exact timings may vary.

question: What documents are required for admission?
answer: The documents required for admission to SRIT depend on the course and admission category. Students may need their qualifying examination marks memo, transfer certificate, study certificates, entrance examination rank card and hall ticket, Aadhaar or another valid ID, photographs, and applicable caste or income certificates. This is a general checklist, not a confirmed official list. Please check the current admission instructions at https://www.srit.ac.in/admission-procedure/ or contact the college office at 9515611111 before submitting documents.
